data.name: AssumedNoSpecialContribution
data.value: So no special social security contribution: not owed in main occupation

data.name: AssumedLowIncomeCredit
data.value: And the tax credit for low earned income on a low pay, the dividend, taxed at source, being left out of your return

data.name: AssumedCalendarYear
data.value: The company's accounting year is the calendar year

data.name: AssumedSteadyState
data.value: Each year pays out its own profit, and profits kept from earlier years go out with it at the same rate

data.name: AssumedFinalContributions
data.value: Social contributions are the final amount owed on this year's income

data.name: LimitReserves
data.value: The company-law tests on what can be paid out, and the liquidation reserve: profits kept from earlier years are taken as ordinary retained earnings.

data.name: LimitDisallowed
data.value: Disallowed expenses other than the vouchers', and losses carried forward from earlier years.

data.name: LimitManagementFee
data.value: Your social insurance fund's management fee, charged on top of the contributions, until you give its rate on Director pay.

data.name: LimitTaxCalc
data.value: The 2026 figures are computed from the official 2026 amounts. Tax-Calc does not cover 2026 yet; on 2025, the same method matches it to the cent on the income tax, the tax credit for low earned income, the dividend refund, and the surcharge and bonus on your advance payments.
